# Closed-Loop Design Template

## Goal

Define one repository-specific outcome and scope.

## Observe

Name the repository or GitHub signals that reveal current state.

## Act

List the smallest allowed actions and ownership boundaries.

## Verify

Define deterministic checks that can disprove success.

## Decide

Explain how evidence selects retry, completion, or escalation.

## Stop Condition

Set completion, budget, safety, and human escalation conditions.
